name: Vacuum extension socket test
description: 52 mm long test piece with the same socket as the back of the vacuum extension: 45 mm deep on the flat side, with the rim cut at a slant so the wall on the rounded side is 15 mm shorter, to match the slanted collar of the old brush extension. Check that the old tongue goes in and the collar sits flat on the rim all round. Prints standing on the plug end, socket opening up, no supports. Not printed or fitted.
